Get VTB Infobasket Playoff

Source: R/vtb.R
vtb_infobasket_playoff.Rd

Playoff bracket of a playoff stage, one row per series.

Endpoint: GET https://org.infobasket.su/Widget/PlayOff/{comp_id}

Usage

vtb_infobasket_playoff(comp_id)

Arguments

comp_id

Stage CompID (comp_id in vtb_infobasket_comp_issue), not a season id and not an END year, e.g. 50720 (Regular Season 2025-26) or 54281 (Playoff 2025-26).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Playoff bracket of a playoff stage, one row per series. The columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py vtb_infobasket_playoff); an empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data, a valid body with no rows for this frame is a zero-row tibble:

col_nametypedescription
comp_idintegerStage CompID the request asked for (50720 = the 2025-26 regular season): a stage below the season, not an END year.
treeintegerBracket tree number (1 = the main bracket).
roundintegerRound as the number of series in it (4 = quarter-finals, 2 = semi-finals, 1 = final).
is_current_roundlogicalTrue for the round in progress.
sortintegerSeries order within the round.
round_name_rucharacterRound name, Russian.
round_name_encharacterRound name, English.
score1integerSeries wins of side 1.
score2integerSeries wins of side 2.
is_finallogicalTrue for a final (decided) result.
winnerintegerSeries winner: 1 side 1, 2 side 2.
team1_idintegerInfobasket TeamID of team 1.
team1_short_name_rucharacterThe team 1 of the series's short name in Russian (as the competition names it).
team1_short_name_encharacterThe team 1 of the series's short name in English (as the competition names it).
team1_name_rucharacterThe team 1 of the series's name in Russian (as the competition names it).
team1_name_encharacterThe team 1 of the series's name in English (as the competition names it).
team1_region_name_rucharacterThe team 1 of the series's region or city in Russian (as the competition names it).
team1_region_name_encharacterThe team 1 of the series's region or city in English (as the competition names it).
team2_idintegerInfobasket TeamID of team 2.
team2_short_name_rucharacterThe team 2 of the series's short name in Russian (as the competition names it).
team2_short_name_encharacterThe team 2 of the series's short name in English (as the competition names it).
team2_name_rucharacterThe team 2 of the series's name in Russian (as the competition names it).
team2_name_encharacterThe team 2 of the series's name in English (as the competition names it).
team2_region_name_rucharacterThe team 2 of the series's region or city in Russian (as the competition names it).
team2_region_name_encharacterThe team 2 of the series's region or city in English (as the competition names it).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in vtb_infobasket_seasons().
